title: Dry floodproofed spaces.
officialText:
The certificate of occupancy shall describe any dry floodproofed spaces as “dry floodproofed.”
For such buildings containing dwelling units, patient care areas (for flood zone purposes) or spaces intended to be used by persons
for sleeping purposes, the certificate of occupancy shall also provide notations as required by Section G304.1.2, Item 2.2.5. Where
flood shields or other flood control devices are installed, the certificate of occupancy shall also provide notations describing these
features.
